title: Clinic appointment booking — patient and staff flows

facts.text: Patients book appointments online via website and mobile app
A selected slot is held for 10 minutes while the patient confirms
Patients can join a waitlist when no slots are free
Reminder SMS sent 24 hours before the appointment
Cancellation allowed up to 2 hours before the appointment
Doctors set weekly availability from a staff dashboard
No online payment in phase one — patients pay at the clinic desk
Patient-facing screens support Hindi and English
Walk-in patients appear on the same schedule as booked patients
Admin dashboard shows the day's appointments per doctor and clinic
Monthly no-show report per doctor and per clinic
Patient data protected; access limited to the booking clinic's staff
